title: Customer Invoice report cannot be downloaded without Invoicing & payments - View
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as user B, whose role has Reports on and Invoicing & payments - View off, at the test location.
  • Have an invoice made today at the test location, invoice A, by an Admin.
  • Use a second browser, or a private window, signed in as an Admin at the test location, with the Export Report dialog open, so you can see the same report download for someone allowed.
  • Start on Reports, then Export Reports in the Reports left menu, with the Export Report dialog open.
custom_steps:
1. Pick Customer Invoice in the Report Name list.
  2. Set the date range to today.
  3. Click Download.
  4. In the second browser, pick Customer Invoice in the Report Name list.
  5. In the second browser, set the date range to today.
  6. In the second browser, click Download.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer Invoice is offered in the Report Name list for user B and is picked: the entry is not hidden.

Step 2:

  • The date range shows today's date.

Step 3:

  • No Customer Invoice file downloads for user B.

Step 4:

  • Customer Invoice is picked in Report Name.

Step 5:

  • The date range shows today's date.

Step 6:

  • A Customer Invoice file downloads for the Admin, with invoice A's rows in it: the report has data, so user B's empty-handed download comes from the missing permission.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks)

  • Story 3, Prerequisites: “Downloading the report requires Invoicing & payments - View. The gate is enforced on the server, not by hiding the entry in the Export Reports dialog.”
